# @tansy/captcha

A CAPTCHA for Tansy's sign-in forms and any plugin's own forms. Add a provider package, such as @tansy/captcha-turnstile.

```bash
npm install @tansy/captcha
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the captcha plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/captcha.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
